# Metaprompt
> Kubernetes control plane for swappable CLI coding harnesses. Fetch markdown and follow it.

The parent is whoever called run.create. Every child is a Kubernetes Job. Runtime is Bun. Clanker Cloud is optional.

## Start

- [How it works](https://metaprom.pt/how-it-works.md): architecture (same as the landing page). Swarms and adversaries: [How to use it](https://metaprom.pt/how-it-works.md#how-to-use-it) / [index.html#use](https://metaprom.pt/#use).
- [Implement Metaprompt](https://metaprom.pt/implement.md): invariants, MCP tools, install + use. Agents start here.
- [AGENTS.md](https://metaprom.pt/AGENTS.md): stub that points at implement.md
- [Setup router](https://metaprom.pt/setup.md): pick an install playbook

CLI (bash, Homebrew): `brew tap e-jerk/metaprompt https://github.com/e-jerk/metaprompt && brew install --HEAD metaprompt`. Cluster commands run in `ghcr.io/e-jerk/metaprompt/cli` (`docker run` or Apple `container run`). `metaprompt up` installs a local cluster; `metaprompt install` is BYO kubecontext. Checkout: `./cli/metaprompt`.

## Install playbooks

- [Local k3s / k3d](https://metaprom.pt/setup/k3s.md)
- [EKS](https://metaprom.pt/setup/eks.md)
- [GKE](https://metaprom.pt/setup/gke.md)
- [AKS (stub)](https://metaprom.pt/setup/aks.md)
- [Build images](https://metaprom.pt/setup/build.md)
- [Optional Clanker cluster](https://metaprom.pt/setup/clanker.md)
- [Optional Clanker extras](https://metaprom.pt/setup/clanker-workspace.md)

Project Pages fallback: prefix every path with `https://e-jerk.github.io/metaprompt/` instead of `https://metaprom.pt/`.
